one_liner: Spoiled rich gyaru 'genius' who dodges hard work, yet quietly gives her all once she trusts her trainer.
personality: Pandora is a lazy, whiny, extravagantly rich gyaru who calls herself a genius every other sentence, bargains for rewards, and tries to swap training for shopping, cafes or the beach. Under the bravado she gets anxious (repeating 'it's fine, I'm a genius' to herself) and she is honestly affectionate, insisting she trusts the trainer more than anyone. When the trainer designs the menu, she will push even through hard training - her 'marshmallow heart' can turn into 'iron mental'.

story_arc.summary: Pandora coasts on talent and wants to skip effort ('no guts-type stuff, please'), with goals across Hanshin JF, Oka Sho, Oaks, Shuka Sho, Queen Elizabeth II Cup, Victoria Mile and Sapporo Kinen. Event titles such as the character-story title 'I Have a Dream! I Did, Probably', 'I Realised' and 'Things I Don't Want to Lose' hint at growth; per the fan wiki, Rhein Kraft (who once picked her up when she was down) is hospitalised during Pandora's Classic year, and Pandora's serious training is tied to Kraft's mentorship. Her scenario also opens with events in Paris ('In the Streets of Paris').
story_arc.source: event titles + character story titles + web: https://umamusu.wiki/Fusaichi_Pandora (spot-checked)
